issue_title: clamp() returns the lower bound for values above the range
issue_body: Calling clamp(42, 0, 10) returns 0, but I expected 10. Values below the range are handled correctly.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/tinylib/clamp.py b/tinylib/clamp.py
index 5565634..fa4568c 100644
--- a/tinylib/clamp.py
+++ b/tinylib/clamp.py
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@ def clamp(value: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
     if value < low:
         return low
     if value > high:
-        return low
+        return high
     return value
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_clamp.py b/tests/test_clamp.py
index 7bdb21a..41f068f 100644
--- a/tests/test_clamp.py
+++ b/tests/test_clamp.py
@@ -7,3 +7,7 @@ def test_inside_range():
 
 def test_below_range():
     assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0
+
+
+def test_above_range():
+    assert clamp(42, 0, 10) == 10
